assertion.text: Erdős Problem #838: declared status 'open'. Formalized: no. Let $f(n)$ be maximal such that any $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$, with no three on a line, determine at least $f(n)$ different convex subsets. Estimate $f(n)$ - in particular, does there exist a constant $c$ such that\[\lim \frac{\log f(n)}{(\log n)^2}=c?\] Prize: no. Tags: convex, geometry.
